title: Automation, analytics and artificial intelligence for chemical synthesis
source_summary: Automation and real-time monitoring, combined with machine learning and AI, are transforming synthetic chemistry by enabling data-rich, interdisciplinary experimentation that accelerates discovery and optimizes reaction conditions.
abstract: Automation and real-time reaction monitoring have enabled data-rich experimentation, which is critically important in navigating the complexities of chemical synthesis. Linking real-time analysis with machine learning and artificial intelligence tools provides the opportunity to accelerate the identification of optimal reaction conditions and facilitate error-free autonomous synthesis. This Comment provides a viewpoint underscoring the growing significance of data-rich experiments and interdisciplinary approaches in driving future progress in synthetic chemistry.
